params.name: grid
params.type: See inferred contract; exact native ABI is not source-confirmed

comparison: exact typed result with lossless large-integer wire encoding
effects: Inputs and nested containers unchanged; returned mutable snapshots are independent; internal class state may mutate

qualification.reason: Author-local runs against inferred preview contracts only; no exact hidden-variant confirmation or independent qualification

source_reasoning.candidate_design: BFS the ordered pair of car positions; combine their five possible moves, excluding occupancy and edge-swap collisions.
source_reasoning.complexity_target: O(open cells squared) states and space; at most 25 transitions per state
source_reasoning.reference: Layered sets built with grid-wide move enumeration rather than candidate adjacency tables.
source_reasoning.limits: Only bounded author-development cases are executed; full official domain/resource suitability is unknown

numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: Find the fewest synchronous ticks moving each car in four directions or waiting until both reach their own marked destination. Walls are impassable. Cars cannot share a cell or swap endpoints of an edge in one tick. Reaching a destination does not freeze movement. These collision and timing rules are explicit inferences because the preview stops before them.
